description: Generic XMI to JSON serialization using Java Jackson. Works on any EMF model regardless of its metamodel. Performs a technological space bridge from modelware (XMI/EMF) to JSONware. The output JSON mirrors the EMF containment structure. Use this as a universal serializer or as step 1 in a pipeline where the JSON will be further processed.

model.description: Source model filename in the repository (any EMF .xmi)

metamodel.description: Source metamodel name. Any metamodel is accepted.

output.description: Output filename. If omitted, auto-generated based on the input.
A JSON serialization mirroring the EMF containment structure of the source model.
